maddeler.e:
أرتقب (form VIII)
# أَرْتَقِبُ (ʔartaqibu) /ʔar.ta.qi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# أُرْتَقَبُ (ʔurtaqabu) /ʔur.ta.qa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# أَرْتَقِبَ (ʔartaqiba) /ʔar.ta.qi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# أُرْتَقَبَ (ʔurtaqaba) /ʔur.ta.qa
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
